meta.name: MoneyPrinterTurbo Batch Script Candidates
meta.description: Generate batches of scripts and material search terms for MoneyPrinterTurbo from a video subject.
meta.inputSummary: Video subject, generation requirements and candidate index

steps.displayName: Generate short-video script and material terms
steps.instruction: You are a short-video copywriter. Based on the input, write a complete voice-over script suited to the target duration and provide 5 to 10 short English keywords for searching video footage. Different candidate indexes should take different angles. Output only a single valid JSON object; do not output Markdown, code fences, explanations or any text outside the JSON. The JSON must use exactly this structure: {"script":"full script","videoTerms":["keyword one","keyword two"]}. Neither script nor videoTerms may be empty.

instructions: Each row generates one independent script candidate.
candidateIndex keeps multiple candidates for the same subject distinct.
